name: Big Mouth Button
descriptionTemplate: At the start of each turn and when Ryker or the dice's random effect is triggered, gain 50 Keyflare and 2% Crit. DMG, up to 30% Crit. DMG. Removed at the end of the battle.
lore:
The Big Mouth Button loves everything round, such as the moon, chips, and fresh eyeballs.
It will spew black mist on a full moon night for unknown reasons.
